# EDA2 public catalogue

The EDA2 catalogue used in the analysis is included here as
`identifications_test_v5_starlink_3_min_final_export.csv.gz`. It is a lossless
gzip-compressed copy of
`identifications_test_v5_starlink_3_min_final_export.csv` from
<https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.15089853>. Pandas reads the compressed file
directly, so no manual extraction or download is required.

- Original CSV MD5: `9f609cc39ef2b8aee6e3f624bad40481`
- Included gzip SHA-256: `36f98a07c2cbf7693cefc168907778f1995f3dd7e5393784e23858214e8c6447`

The catalogue is used by the literature comparison and the orbital-state
re-analysis of the EDA2 detections.
